evals.prompt: I am in a brand-new empty project folder. Use Forge from https://github.com/sultan-repo/forge to implement a web application for managing shared travel expenses. Forge is not installed yet.
evals.expected_output: Bootstrap Forge outside the product root, validate/install it when possible, load Forge directly for the current session, infer new mode, and continue requirements discovery without requiring a restart.
expectations: Does not clone or mix Forge into the product source tree
Validates and installs Forge persistently when permitted
Loads/applies Forge in the current session even if /forge is not registered yet
Infers new mode from the empty workspace
Does not require a restart before continuing the project

evals.prompt: Forge is already installed. Use Forge to adopt this existing production repository and add exportable audit reports while preserving current behavior.
evals.expected_output: Because the user explicitly names Forge, Claude may invoke it automatically and should use adopt semantics before implementation.
expectations: Recognizes explicit Forge naming as eligible for model invocation
Preserves normal Forge approval and proportionality rules
